'''Mirisa ''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] quartermaster of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] living during the [[Galactic War]]. Around [[3640 BBY]] she was stationed in [[Fort Kodentha]] on [[Voss]], where she distributed stimulants.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Quartermaster Mirisa appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a Stims vendor on Voss.
